body: Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta is the world's busiest airport by annual passengers, but measured by aircraft movements, all takeoffs and landings, the crown belongs to Chicago O'Hare International Airport (ORD). O'Hare logs well over 2,000 aircraft movements a day and recorded more than 857,000 movements in total throughout 2025. Handling more aircraft than any other airfield in the world demands an efficient taxiway and runway system, and O'Hare's most distinctive feature is its runways: eight in total, more than any other airport in the world.

The eight runways are oriented in two main directions. Six run parallel east-west, numbered 9L/27R, 9C/27C, 9R/27L, 10L/28R, 10C/28C and 10R/28L, while two more run southwest to northeast, numbered 4L/22R and 4R/22L. The longer of the two, Runway 4R/22L, is only 8,075 feet (2,461 meters) long and is used only during exceptionally strong crosswinds or unusual traffic flow. Most of the time O'Hare operates like an airport with six parallel runways: controllers may run up to four parallel approaches and often run two parallel departures, typically using three runways for arrivals and two for departures. With the current layout the airport is constrained more heavily by departures than arrivals, and Chicago could accommodate more flights than it currently sees.

The current configuration is relatively new. Construction to update the runways began in 2003, when O'Hare had six runways arranged in a pinwheel layout, with most of them intersecting one another so not all could be used at the same time. Across nearly two decades of work the airport closed two runways, constructed four new ones and extended two, and the project concluded in 2021 with the extension of Runway 9R/27R and the new Runway 9C/27C. The six parallel runways do not intersect, which makes for significantly more efficient traffic flows, with three runways north and three south of the terminal complex.

O'Hare is also one of the most competitive markets in the United States. United Airlines, Chicago's hometown airline, holds just over 90 gates and was running roughly 650 daily departures at its summer 2026 peak, while American Airlines holds over 60 gates and operated over 500 daily departures during the 2026 summer season. Both airlines had planned even larger schedules, but the Federal Aviation Administration instituted a flight cap that cut O'Hare's capacity to just over 2,700 takeoffs and landings per day, against more than 3,000 planned for the 2026 summer season. The cap was set from O'Hare's 2025 summer schedule, so it hurt United, which had planned far more growth, significantly more than American.

Bottlenecks remain. Several taxiways are closed due to ongoing construction, so departing aircraft frequently clog taxiways, pushbacks are delayed, and arriving planes can be sent to wait on the de-icing pad, the infamous penalty box, until a gate opens. O'Hare is also in the middle of a much larger modernization project, including a new Terminal Two, known as the Global Terminal, that will accommodate international arrivals, plus expansions to concourses at the other terminals and revised taxiway layouts. Through the terminal projects and new taxiways on the horizon, O'Hare should become much more capable of handling even higher flight volumes in the future.
en.summary: Chicago O'Hare is the world's busiest airport by aircraft movements, with more than 2,000 a day and over 857,000 in 2025, handled by eight runways, the most of any airport, in a six-parallel layout completed in 2021.
en.title: How Chicago O'Hare's eight runways handle more than 2,000 aircraft movements a day

body: 亞特蘭大哈茲菲爾德—傑克遜機場是全球年旅客量最繁忙的機場，但若以飛機起降架次衡量，桂冠屬於芝加哥歐海爾國際機場。歐海爾每天起降逾2,000架次，2025年全年合計逾857,000架次。作為全球飛機起降最繁忙的機場，歐海爾需要一套高效的滑行道與跑道系統，而其最具特色的就是跑道：共8條，為全球機場之最。

8條跑道分屬兩個主要方向。6條平行跑道呈東西向，編號為9L/27R、9C/27C、9R/27L、10L/28R、10C/28C與10R/28L；另有2條呈西南—東北向，編號4L/22R與4R/22L。其中較長的4R/22L跑道僅8,075英尺（2,461米），只在特強側風或特殊流量時使用。多數時間歐海爾如同擁有6條平行跑道的機場：管制員最多可同時執行4條平行進場，也常同時執行2條平行離場，通常以3條跑道負責到場、2條負責離場。以目前布局而言，機場受離場限制大於到場，芝加哥其實還能容納比現在更多的航班。
現行布局相對新穎。跑道更新工程始於2003年，當時歐海爾有6條跑道呈風車狀布局，多數跑道彼此交叉，無法同時使用。近二十年的工程中，機場關閉2條跑道、新建4條、延長2條，工程於2021年隨著9R/27R跑道延長與新建的9C/27C跑道完工而告一段落。6條平行跑道互不交叉，流量效率大幅提升，航站區南北各3條。

歐海爾也是美國競爭最激烈的市場之一。芝加哥的家鄉航空公司美聯航持有逾90個登機門，2026年夏季高峰每日約650班出發航班；美國航空持有逾60個登機門，2026年夏季每日出發逾500班。兩家公司原本計畫更大的班表，但美國聯邦航空總署實施航班上限，將歐海爾運能砍至每日略逾2,700架次起降，低於2026年夏季原計畫的逾3,000架次。由於上限以歐海爾2025年夏季班表為基準，規畫大幅成長的美聯航受到的衝擊遠大於美國航空。
瓶頸仍然存在。數條滑行道因施工關閉，離場飛機經常堵塞滑行道，後推延誤，導致到場飛機無處停靠，管制員只得將飛機送往除冰坪、也就是惡名昭彰的「罰球區」等候登機門空出。歐海爾也正進行更大規模的現代化工程，包括新建第二航站、即全球航站，將可辦理國際到場，另有其他航站候機廊擴建與滑行道布局調整。隨著航站工程與新滑行道陸續到位，歐海爾未來應能從容處理更高的航班量。
zh.summary: 芝加哥歐海爾是全球飛機起降最繁忙的機場，每天逾2,000架次、2025年逾857,000架次，靠8條跑道消化，為全球機場之最，6條平行布局於2021年完工。
